modal.title: Appeal a punishment
modal.reasonHint: Why should you be unbanned, unmuted or unwarned?
modal.codeHint: From the DM you got when you were punished, e.g. k7m2qx.
modal.moreHint: Anything else the administrators should know.

report.title: Report a staff member
report.proofHint: Links to screenshots or messages, one per line

wrongPlace.report: Staff reports are filed from the panel in the Mewvo support server.
wrongPlace.panel: Use the appeal panel in a server.

appeal.badCode: That is not a valid case code. It is 5–7 letters and digits, from the DM you received.

submitted.title: Appeal submitted
submitted.text: The administrators will review it. You'll get a DM with the decision.

reportSent.title: Report submitted
reportSent.text: Your report was submitted to the administrators. If they ask for screenshot proof, please post it in your DMs with them.

appeal.formGone: This form is not available here any more. Open it again from the panel.

error.notFound: That case code was not found for your account. Check the code in your DM.
error.lifted: This case has already been lifted.
error.endedBan: This ban has already ended, so there is nothing to appeal.
error.endedMute: This mute has already ended, so there is nothing to appeal.
error.windowClosed: The appeal window for this ban has closed.

windowKick.one: Kicks can only be appealed within {count} day.
windowKick.other: Kicks can only be appealed within {count} days.

windowWarn.one: Warnings can only be appealed within {count} day.
windowWarn.other: Warnings can only be appealed within {count} days.

error.pending: You already have a pending appeal for this case. You will get a DM with the decision.
error.cooldown: Your last appeal for this case was denied. You can appeal again {when}.
error.reportsToday: You have sent the maximum number of staff reports for today. Please try again tomorrow.
error.reportOpen: You already have an open staff report. The administrators will contact you about it.
error.serverUnavailable: That server is not available right now. Nothing was sent.

channel.title: Your appeal for {code}
channel.footer: Staff will review it here. You can add more details or screenshots in this channel. You get the decision by DM.

result.dm: You got the details by DM.
result.noDm: You will not get the details by DM (your DMs are closed).
result.deleted: -# This channel is deleted in {seconds} seconds.

record.title: My record in {server}
record.expiry: -# Warnings do not expire. One stops counting when staff remove it, it is lifted on appeal, or you reach the limit (then the count starts again at the next stage).
record.ladderOff: Warnings are recorded but never lead to an automatic ban in this server (the warn ladder is off).
record.oneAfter: The one after it would mean an automatic ban ({ban}).

moreAfter.one: {count} more after it would mean an automatic ban ({ban}).
moreAfter.other: {count} more after it would mean an automatic ban ({ban}).

record.limit: It would reach the warning limit: an automatic ban ({ban}, warning stage {stage} of 3).

myAppeals.title: My appeals
myAppeals.none: You have not filed any appeals. Press **Appeal** on the appeal panel to file one; you need the case code from the DM you got.
myAppeals.claimed: Waiting for a decision. Someone on the staff team is looking at it.
myAppeals.head: **`{code}`**: {type} ({name})

modmail.promptOne: Do you want to send this message to {staff}? They will reply here in DMs.
modmail.promptSeveral: Which server's staff should get this message? They will reply here in DMs.
modmail.promptMore: -# Only the first {count} servers are listed.
modmail.none: None of the servers you share with this bot takes modmail (or you are not a member there any more). Ask that server's staff another way. If you were banned from the Mewvo server, use the appeal panel in the support server.
modmail.unavailable: Modmail is not available right now.
modmail.notMemberMain: Modmail is for members of the Mewvo server. If you were banned, use the appeal panel in the support server.
modmail.notMember: You are not a member of {server}, so its staff can't be reached through modmail.
modmail.alreadyOpen: You already have an open conversation. Just send your messages here.
modmail.notTaking: {server} does not take modmail right now.
modmail.gone: That message is gone. Send it again.
modmail.sentMain: Sent to staff. They will reply here; anything else you send here goes to them too.
modmail.sentOther: Sent to the staff of {server}. They will reply here; anything else you send here goes to them too.
modmail.broken: That prompt is broken. Send your message again.
modmail.failed: Could not reach the staff right now. Please try again later.
modmail.closedAgain: Send a new message here any time to start another one.

contest.title: Contest this decision
contest.label: Why was this OK?
contest.hint: A moderator will read this and decide.
contest.broken: That button is broken (no case code).
contest.already: You already contested this decision. The moderators will look at it.
contest.sent: A moderator will review case {code} with your explanation. You'll get a DM if it is reversed.
contest.notYours: Only the member this decision was about can contest it.
contest.notAuto: Only automatic decisions can be contested here. Use the appeal form instead.

keepApart.asked: Staff have asked you and {other} not to contact each other until {until}.
keepApart.rule: Until then, do not mention or reply to them in the server: those messages are removed.
keepApart.notPunishment: This is not a punishment and does not count as a warning.
